descricao_original: These neurons contain a euchromatic nucleus with a well-defined nucleolus. The nucleolus is the site of ribosomal RNA transcription and the initial assembly of ribosomes. Nuclei generally have one nucleolus; however, multiple nucleoli are common in highly active cells, such as liver cells. 1000x
creditos_identificados: Image source: Image was taken of a slide from the Virtual Microscopy Laboratory (http://www.histologyguide.com)
